title: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) (Amendment) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE LAND (RESTRICTIONS ON ALIENATION) ACT, NO. 38 OF 2014
gazette_note: Published as a Supplement to Part II of the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka of August 03, 2018

edition.caveat: the Government Printer PDF is a 4-page 1-bit scan with no text layer, so the tree was read by OCR and then corrected by eye against the scan

source_location.note: Page 1 is the Government Printer cover, page 4 the imprint. Sections 1 and 2 are on page 2; section 2's inserted paragraph runs over onto page 3, which also carries sections 3 and 4.

text_convention.raw_text: exactly what the OCR read, uncorrected.
text_convention.text: the wording as printed, corrected by eye against the scan.
text_convention.corrections: every character that differs between the two, so nothing is changed silently.
text_convention.why: An OCR misreading recorded in a notes field but still used as the value is a wrong value with a footnote. Targets, operations and text carry the corrected reading; raw_text keeps the machine's version so the correction can be audited.

corroboration.sections_1_and_2: Independently confirmed word for word against LankaLaw's HTML edition, which is truncated but accurate as far as it runs. Two sources agree on this text.
corroboration.sections_3_and_4: OCR only. LankaLaw's page stops before them, so the correction rests on reading the scan and has no second source. These two sections are the weakest part of this tree.

verification_note: Structure and instruction targets are correct and the OCR errors have been corrected against the scan. Sections 3 and 4 rest on a single reading of a 200 dpi bitonal scan with no second source, so the wording still needs a person to sign it off.

provenance.against: Government Printer PDF pages 2 and 3, read directly; sections 1 and 2 cross-checked against LankaLaw's HTML
provenance.what_changed: Corrected every OCR misreading rather than only recording it, so targets, operations and text now carry the printed wording. Restored the long title, section 2's heading and its quoted substituted paragraph with its proviso. Removed page headers that OCR had folded into section 2. Put the dates into ISO form.
provenance.note: Re-running scripts/parse_amendment_pdf.py writes data/processed/canonical-amendments/21-2018.json, not this file. scripts/finalize_statute.py leaves a tree carrying provenance.hand_corrected in place.

quality_flags: sections 3 and 4 rest on a single OCR reading of a bitonal scan, with no second source to check them against
